name: kiln-next
description: Classes for the Kiln runtime, under the holding name kiln-next until the old kiln plugin retires. Ships the Crafter (changes the artifact), the Designer (the shape skill: a main-thread design dialogue that ends at a written decision), the Planner (turns a decision into a ticket plan with rerunnable checks), and the Inspector (rules once per build job on conformance to the plan). Dispatched by Class from a job plan by the fire skill.
